_comment: Folio legal docs manifest. Source of truth for the latest ToS / Privacy version: a GitHub Action syncs this into Supabase tos_versions (which the app reads), and it is also bundled into the app as an offline fallback. Bump version + summary when ToS / Privacy changes.

terms.summary_zh: 本次更新《服務條款》第 10 條「付費功能」與第 06 條的分享圖說明。一、支持方案新增年繳：確認購買時一次收取一整年的費用（有免費試用的，試用結束時才收），之後每年自動續訂；也寫明 iPhone 與 Android 取消訂閱的位置。二、新增免費試用：天數與您是否符合資格，以購買當下 App 與商店顯示為準；每個 App Store 或 Google Play 帳戶限用一次，各方案共用；試用期間取消不會扣款，仍可使用到試用結束；若沒有在試用結束 24 小時前取消，試用結束時會依您選擇的方案與週期扣款並自動續訂；試用期間不提供支持者勳章（先前已取得者除外），也不能變更方案。三、方案變更依方案等級（超級支持者年繳＞超級支持者月繳＞支持者年繳＞支持者月繳）：改訂較高等級立即生效，改訂較低等級於當期結束時生效；實際生效時間與收費以 App 內確認畫面與商店顯示為準。四、補充訂閱結束後，月曆底圖、便利貼紙樣、分享圖與回顧卡、製作桌布、書房每月新素材與雲端備份等訂閱限定項目如何處理；並寫明部分功能的免費次數與每日上限以 App 內顯示為準。已向所有用戶無期限免費提供的功能或素材不會改為收費；若 App 內標示限時免費開放某些訂閱限定項目，期間結束後恢復為訂閱限定，期間內已套用、已製作或已存的內容照樣保留。雲端備份為盡力保存，不保證完整或永久。五、分享圖條款涵蓋回顧卡、書摘卡等所有分享圖。
terms.summary_en: This update changes Section 10, "Paid Features", and the share-image clause in Section 06 of the Terms of Service. First, support plans now offer yearly billing: the full year is charged when you confirm the purchase (or, with a free trial, when the trial ends), and the plan then renews every year; we also say where to cancel on iPhone and Android. Second, free trials: the trial length and whether you are eligible are as shown in the app and in the store at the time of purchase; each App Store or Google Play account can use one free trial, shared across all plans; if you cancel during the trial you won't be charged and you keep access until the trial ends; unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends, you will be charged for the plan and billing period you chose and the subscription renews automatically; there is no supporter badge during a trial (unless you received it before), and plans cannot be changed during a trial. Third, plan changes follow plan level (Super Supporter yearly > Super Supporter monthly > Supporter yearly > Supporter monthly): moving to a higher level takes effect immediately, and moving to a lower level takes effect at the end of the current period; the actual timing and charges are as shown on the in-app confirmation screen and by the store. Fourth, we describe what happens to subscriber-only items when a subscription ends (calendar backgrounds, sticky-note papers, share images and recap cards, the wallpaper maker, each month's new study-room assets, and cloud backup), and state that free-use counts and daily limits for some features are as shown in the app. We will not start charging for anything we have made free for all users without a stated time limit; if the app marks some subscriber-only items as free for a limited time, they become subscriber-only again when that period ends, and anything you applied, made, or saved during it is kept. Cloud backup is best-effort and not guaranteed to be complete or permanent. Fifth, the share-image clause now covers all share images, including recap cards and quote cards.

privacy.summary_zh: 本次更新配合 App 1.0.17 與 1.0.18 的新功能。一、匯入書單：您挑選的 Goodreads 或 StoryGraph 匯出檔只在您的裝置上解析，上傳的只有書名、作者文字、是否已讀，以及已讀那一列的讀完日期；ISBN 只用來比對書目，比對完即丟棄；評分、書評、其他書架名稱與檔案本身都不上傳。二、Folio 的伺服器每天向 Open Library 取得公開的熱門書單，英文書目也取自其公開資料集，這些連線不含任何個人資料。三、閱讀日誌：書櫃的開始與讀完日期、閱讀時間、閱讀目標與書房紀念品，以及打卡紀錄的文字，存在 Folio 的伺服器，只有您本人看得到（閱讀時間另用於不識別個人的整體統計），換手機也會回來；打卡照片、分享圖與草稿、自己上傳的底圖與各項設定平常只存在您的手機，您是支持者（含免費試用）時會自動備份到 Folio 的私有儲存空間，成為支持者時先前的也會一併補傳，上傳前清除照片的位置資訊、清不掉的照片不上傳，可在「設定 → 備份」關閉，不再是支持者後已備份的仍保留、可下載回手機。掃描文本的文字辨識完全在手機上進行，圖片不上傳；Android 版「設成桌布」只在您按下按鈕時更換一次。四、新增閱讀證：正面是頭像、暱稱、心態與加入 Folio 的月份（只到月份），背面是初版讀者章與支持者章。自本版起閱讀證預設公開（既有帳號於您同意本版政策時轉為公開），其他用戶點您的頭像就看得到；您可隨時在「我」頁點頭像，於「我的閱讀證」關閉「讓別人看到我的閱讀證」（請先更新至最新版 App）。五、回覆漂流瓶在成立筆友之前改為雙向匿名。六、分享圖功能會記錄不含內容的使用紀錄（例如版型、比例、分享去向的大類），每人每天同一類只記一次。七、訂閱紀錄另記方案週期（月繳或年繳）與是否在免費試用期，試用期間不顯示支持者勳章（先前已取得者除外）。八、新增加拿大用戶適用之法律（PIPEDA 與魁北克省法律）、資料存放於加拿大境外之說明、加拿大用戶之權利，以及隱私負責人之聯絡方式。《服務條款》同時更新為 1.9 版。
privacy.summary_en: This update covers new features in app 1.0.17 and 1.0.18. First, Import your library: the Goodreads or StoryGraph export file you pick is parsed only on your device, and only the book title, the author text, whether a row is marked as read, and the date read for rows marked as read are uploaded; an ISBN is used only to match our catalogue and is discarded afterwards; ratings, reviews, other shelf names, and the file itself are never uploaded. Second, Folio's server fetches the public trending list from Open Library once a day, and our English catalogue comes from its public dataset; these requests contain no personal data. Third, the Reading journal: your books' started and finished dates, reading time, reading goals, study-room keepsakes, and the text of your check-ins are stored on Folio's servers and visible only to you (reading time is also used for aggregate, non-identifying statistics), so they come back when you change phones; check-in photos, share images and drafts, backgrounds you upload, and settings normally stay only on your phone, and while you are a supporter (including a free trial) they are backed up automatically to Folio's private storage, including what was already on your phone when you become a supporter, with location data cleared from photos first (a photo whose location data cannot be cleared is not uploaded); you can turn this off in Settings > Backup, and after you stop being a supporter what was backed up is kept and can be downloaded to your phone. Scan text recognises text entirely on your phone and never uploads the images; on Android, "Set as wallpaper" changes your wallpaper once, only when you tap the button. Fourth, the new Reader's card: the front shows your avatar, nickname, mode, and the month you joined Folio (month only), and the back shows the First Edition reader stamp and the supporter stamp. From this version, reader's cards are public by default (an existing account's card becomes public when you accept this version of the policy), so other users can see yours by tapping your avatar; you can turn off "Let others see my reader's card" at any time by tapping your avatar on the "Me" page and opening "My reader's card" (please update to the latest version of the app first). Fifth, replies to drift bottles are now anonymous in both directions until a pen-pal connection is made. Sixth, share-image features log usage records that contain no content (for example the layout, the aspect ratio, and a broad category of where you shared to), at most once per kind per person per day. Seventh, subscription records now also include the billing period (monthly or yearly) and whether you are in a free trial, and the supporter badge is not shown during a free trial (unless you received it before). Eighth, we add the laws that apply to users in Canada (PIPEDA and Quebec law), an explanation that their data is stored outside Canada, their rights, and how to reach our privacy officer. The Terms of Service are updated to version 1.9 at the same time.
